thread:
tenant-cs: Heads-up: customer \"ProtonAnalytics\" on a dedicated pool is seeing a sudden spike of 429s + intermittent auth failures after yesterday's autoscale. Started ~08:10 UTC. Symptoms: rapid 429s, some 401s, and increased p95 latency. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex: :eyes: Can you drop the last 5m of request headers/logs (tokens redacted)? Are they sending a plan tag like `X-Plan: reserved-v2` or using billing labels?

tenant-cs: Pasting a couple of snippets we captured. Example request + response: 
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" -H \"X-Plan: reserved-v2\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
x-redwood-ratekey: tenant:proj-proton:rp42
{"error":"rate limit exceeded"}
```
And an auth warning from the API node: 
```json
{"ts":"2025-02-24T08:12:03Z","level":"warn","msg":"auth: token rejected","tenant":"proj-proton","err":"plan tag missing in billing metadata"}
```

maria: Two vectors to check: (1) rate-mapper can drop plan/billing tags during concurrent metadata reloads, (2) auth service can fallback to a lower-tier route if plan tag absent -> fast 429s. @infra-sre can you check rate-mapper/reconcile around 08:09-08:15?

infra-sre: On it. Early findings: rate-mapper logged a reconcile churn and restart at ~08:08 when DEPLOY_CANARY was toggled. Sequence looks like:
```
rate-mapper: reconcile loop start
quota-store: load begin
routing: rebuild begin
quota-store: load apply (later) -> routing used stale quota map
```
This ordering race explains requests hitting routes with old/no quota -> 429.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20250224-01 assigned to @alex and @infra-sre

alex: Useful. For repro I can try two steps locally: (1) issue a small burst with valid `X-Plan` then flip the billing metadata to simulate the sync; (2) drop `X-Plan` header entirely to see fallback behavior. What client SDK version is Proton on?

tenant-cs: They use `r-infer-js v0.8.3`. Repro script we ran (locally) shows success -> 200, then after metadata flip -> 429: 
```js
// simulate client burst
for (let i=0;i<50;i++) fetch('/v1/generate',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer X', 'X-Plan':'reserved-v2'}});
// then flip billing metadata on server side (we toggled a test flag)
```

maria: Short-term mitigation: set a per-tenant override to increase the burst ceiling for `proj-proton` and pin the routing plan tag for 1h while we patch. Also hold off on DEPLOY_CANARY for rate-mapper until fix deployed. :thumbsup:

kevin: On the billing side we saw a background subscription-sync job run at 08:07 that overlapped autoscaler rollout. I'll pause that sync for dedicated customers for 30m and coordinate with infra.

alex: Fix plan: (1) ensure `quota-store` updates are applied before `routing` rebuilds (atomic swap or lock), (2) add gating so routing won't accept traffic until quota map present, (3) add audit logging when plan tag is absent so we can correlate quickly. I'll open a PR and do a small canary.

tenant-cs: Applied the temporary override. Errors dropped and latency returned to baseline. We'll monitor and update if anything else shows up. Thanks folks.

maria: I'll own the postmortem: timeline, root cause (race between rate-mapper reload and routing rebuild), mitigations, and action items (code changes + deploy safety guardrails). Will send an initial draft in ~2 hours and tag Proton's ops.

tenant-cs: Appreciate it — please include repro steps and the exact config we toggled so Proton can validate on their side.
